name: Coffee Buttercream
rw:provenance: authored — not from RecipeTin Eats; written to exercise the variant mechanism
rw:note: A true variant, by the rule: the patch swaps one flavouring and nudges one quantity, and touches no steps. Contrast the chocolate buttercream, which changes every quantity and the method, and is therefore a sibling rather than a variant. Everything not named here — method, coverage claims, storage, batch constraints — is inherited from the base, so a fix to the base reaches this file automatically.

rw:adjustments.rw:note: less sweet, to keep the coffee from being buried
